claim: urlsplit separates URL components but does not validate application safety.
reason: Use the standard parser with explicit GitHub-root constraints; no third-party runtime needed.

claim: canonicalize_url sorts query arguments and removes fragments by default.
reason: General crawling semantics are not repository identity. Documentation reviewed; package not installed.

claim: URL represents structured URLs and performs encoding; it does not promise GitHub-root identity.
reason: Compare locally available yarl against the narrow domain contract; do not add dependency for this task.

claim: Repository API owner/repo names are not case sensitive.
reason: Supports lowercase identity keys; existence, redirects and renamed repositories still need API verification.
